A dead stalker. Looks like he wanted to pass something to his acquaintance but didn't make it.
A Zaton stalker, a companion of Gloomy.
Dark's partner, the one who left the stashes.
Documents Beard asked you to recover from a stash on Zaton. Owl may also be interested.
Beard asked you to recover documents from a stash on Zaton. Find the marked box and take the documents.
The documents are found. Take them to Beard at the Skadovsk: he promised 2000 rubles and equipment.
You can return the documents to Beard or look for another buyer. Talk to Pilot at the Skadovsk.
Pilot suggested that Owl might be interested. Owl will pay 5000 rubles, but Beard will be disappointed.
A small locked case. Something heavy is clearly inside. Looks like it can't be opened without a specialist.
The second case mentioned in the Unknown's note. The first one clearly didn't disappoint, so this one should be useful too.
The third case mentioned in the Unknown's notes. Apparently, it's the last one. Need to open it and find out if there's anything else.
Damn... didn't expect there'd be so many of them... The main thing... (coughs blood) Khh, khh... I hope... Dark can find it... The farm... At the farm...
To Dark: the second case is on the bridge above. I think you remember where it is. That kind of thing isn't forgotten, ha ha... The client is waiting for it, so I advise you to hurry.
To Dark: the third case is hidden at the Emerald. I hid it by the stage. The client is getting nervous. Don't fail.
To Dark: we meet as usual, at the gas station. The client's messengers will come there.
The Unknown's dying note mentioned some stashes. I think it's worth finding them all.
The PDA mentions a farm. I think it should be somewhere there.
Maybe the technician can open it.
The note mentions some bridge. It also says it's somewhere "above".
Maybe the technician can open it again.
The note mentions that the stash is hidden by the stage at the Emerald.
Take the third case to the mechanic.
Major wrote that we meet at the gas station. Time to find out what happened there.

[28.07.2012] Major: Hey, Dark. I've stashed the first case. You drop in the artifacts yourself, as we agreed. The key to the cases is at the usual place. Just don't go on a bender like last time.
 [28.07.2012] Dark: I won't go on a bender. The client pays well, everything will be on time. By the way, when does everything need to be ready?
 [28.07.2012] Major: He said to finish by the 30th. Do you have everything?
 [28.07.2012] Dark: Don't worry, it'll all be top-notch.
 [29.07.2012] Major: Well? I dropped by the first stash yesterday to leave the stuff, and I don't see the artifact. Fine, there's still a day, hope you make it. I've tossed a PDA with markers for the next stashes into each one. Write back when you read this.
 [29.07.2012] Major: Where are you? God damn it... This isn't like the previous times, the client is serious. Fuck, we're in trouble now. Fine, I'll try to negotiate. And why don't you even read what I write to you?
 [30.07.2012] Major: God damn it!!! Where are you? The client is furious! Said he'd give us one more day, no more! Fuck, do I really have to go myself again? Answer, quick.
 [1.08.2012] Major: Of course, you're your usual self... Fine, at least I managed to get everything and stash it. God damn it... Because of you we nearly sank again. Anyway, I've marked the gas station. I wrote it in the third stash, in case you actually go through them. We meet tonight.
 [1.08.2012] Major: Where the hell are you? And these messengers... They're nervous...
 [1.08.2012] Major: God d... d-don't come... It's a setup...
Beard, do you have a job involving documents?
There is one thing. A box with documents was hidden on Zaton. Find it and bring the papers to me. I'll pay two thousand and add some equipment. I'll send a mark to your PDA.
Deal. I'll bring the documents.
Beard, I found your documents.
Thanks, you saved me. Here are the promised two thousand, a pistol, ammo, and medical supplies.
Pilot, who might want these documents?
Show them to Owl. He loves rare papers and will probably pay more. But you'll have to explain yourself to Beard afterwards.
Understood. I'll think about who to give them to.
Owl, I hear you're interested in documents.
I am. Five thousand for these. Decide: are you selling or not?
Deal. The documents are yours.
No, I promised to return them to Beard.
Hold on, stalker. I know what papers you're carrying. Hand them over — you'll get two thousand and leave in peace.
All right. Take the documents, give me the money.
I won't give them up for two thousand. Add something.
You'll get nothing. Step aside!
Fine. Two thousand and a Sunrise suit. That's the final offer.
Deal. Money and armor for the documents.
No. The documents stay with me.
Not enough. Give more.
You think I'm a fool? Then we'll take them by force!
Hi, I found a case like this — can you open it?
Hi, it's me with a case again. Could you help once more?
Hi, I found a third case too. Could you help once more?
Let me have a look...
Give it here...
Sure, let's take a look...
(hands over the case)
So... I think I can open it for 2000.
Hmm, it's not much harder than the previous one. I can open it for 2000.
Whoa, what do we have here... You know, this case is a bit more interesting. But still, 2000 is a good price for it.
All right, deal. [-2000 RUB]
I'll think about it.
I don't have that kind of money right now.
